text: Separately prepare and store the following:
Hix 2 parts by volume of A with I part by volume of B; prepare fresh monthly.
1. Prepare thin smears on microscope slides and throughly air dry.
2. Stain 30 sec. with Solution 1; rinse 1 sec. with water.
3. Stain 1 min. with Solution 2; rinse well with water; blot dry.
Examine under oil immersion at l000x magnification with direct
illumination (not phase contrast): blue-violet is positive (either entire
cell or intracellular granules; yellow-brown is negative.
